---
name: ✨ Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement for Smart Dash
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Description**
A clear, concise description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

**Why is this needed?**
What problem or use case does this solve? What do you do today instead?

**Proposed solution (optional)**
How you imagine this working.

**Screenshots / mockups (optional)**
Any visual reference.

**Priority**
- [ ] Low — nice to have
- [ ] Medium — would noticeably improve my workflow
- [ ] High — blocking or significantly limiting how I use the app

**Additional context**
Anything else that might be relevant.
